SMTO-EXE-0213 — SMTO can't securely black out content in PDFs

GUID: e07a9faa-31d4-571a-907e-7a840d01c087
Slug: pdf-redaction-unavailable
Domain: EXE · Subsystem: pdf

What happened

  • SMTO's PDF tools can't permanently remove hidden or sensitive content. Drawing boxes over text only hides it on screen; the words can still be copied out.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Redact the document with a PDF program that has a true redaction feature, which permanently deletes the selected text and images. SMTO has no secure way to remove content, so this must be done with a tool built for it.
  2. Don't ask SMTO to cover sensitive text with boxes or shapes as a substitute. Covered text is still inside the file and can be copied or searched by anyone who receives it.
  3. After redacting, try to search for or copy a removed word in the new file before sharing it. If you can still find the word, it was not truly removed.

What success looks like

  • In the redacted file, searching for a removed word finds nothing, and you can then use SMTO for other PDF tasks on it.

If it still fails

  • Ask the person who manages SMTO or your organization's records team which redaction tool you're approved to use. Don't share the document until the removal has been checked.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Secure PDF redaction is not implemented: the PDF capability report marks redaction unavailable, and no argument change enables it.

What this means

  • Capability reporting states that secure redaction is unavailable in this implementation; there is no verified redaction execution path to enable by changing arguments. PDF parsing and OCR remain local bounded operations on the selected Gateway. Outputs are separate create-only files/artifacts; diagnostic rendering adds no reads, credential recovery, model calls or automatic retries.

Why this can happen

  • Capability reporting states that secure redaction is unavailable in this implementation; there is no verified redaction execution path to enable by changing arguments.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect the advertised redaction capability and keep redaction requirements separate from annotation or overlay features.

How to fix it

  • pdf.capabilities reports redaction.available=false (error_kind pdf.redaction_unavailable); secure content removal and independent verification are deferred, so there is no execution path to enable. Use a separately verified redaction tool, and do not substitute annotation or drawing overlays for redaction.
  • Secure redaction is deferred. Use a separately verified secure redaction workflow; overlays are not redaction.

Retry and execution caution

  • Secure redaction is deferred. Use a separately verified secure redaction workflow; overlays are not redaction.

How to verify the fix

  • A separately supported verified redaction workflow establishes removal before the document is released.

What not to do

  • Never automatically replay uncertain writes or execute embedded document content.

Technical notes

  • PDF parsing and OCR remain local bounded operations on the selected Gateway. Outputs are separate create-only files/artifacts; diagnostic rendering adds no reads, credential recovery, model calls or automatic retries.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
